why: Nothing of the page asks this route. It passes on the settings as the browser gave them, and its test gives them as a plain object. Before a window asks it: the client's own form of the settings, in the ledger.

Nothing of the page asks this route. It passes on the advert's data as the browser gave it, a plain object: the game port answered 400 CALL_INVALID for it, live. Before a window asks it: the client's own form (fleetSvc.py 2371: the advert object's GetData()), in the ledger.
